says: pnpm commits chain reads a step's attested links only from field/runs.jsonl, which takes no new line once ticket 562's build lands, so a link written in a field/runs/ row file is never walked.
proof: commits.ts:749 reads fileAt(rev, "field/runs.jsonl") and nothing under field/runs/; with ticket 562's field-check.ts, any line added to field/runs.jsonl fails the field job (law: every line added to an old log fails at its head line). grep -c attested field/runs.jsonl prints 0, so no link is lost yet.
cost: The first step that logs its links after 562 has nowhere valid to put them: in runs.jsonl CI fails, in a row file p86 and p89 never see them.
